theme.reasoning: Product Breaker requires an aggressive, truth-seeking, 'ruthless' tone. The aesthetic mixes editorial/brutalist roots with premium dark-SaaS structural polish. Heavy contrast, rigid grids, and typography-as-art make the product feel authoritative and high-end rather than messy.

rules.h1: text-6xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
rules.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict rigid grids, generous macro padding, tight micro spacing. Asymmetric editorial compositions where possible.

hero.instructions: Preserve existing bold brutalist/editorial aesthetic (cream bg, black text, red/yellow/blue highlight blocks behind text, grid lines). Ensure global CSS inherits these variables so the rest of the page feels cohesive.

how_it_works.title: Drop the pitch. The panel handles the rest.
how_it_works.layout: Side-by-side or stacked bento. Black section.
how_it_works.instructions: Pure black background. Create a realistic but minimal 'terminal/input' UI. Use mono font for the prompt and neon green (#32D74B) cursor/text highlights. Sharp 1px border. No soft shadows. Use data-testid='terminal-input-mock'.

agents_grid.title: Five Agents. Five Voices. One Verdict.
agents_grid.layout: Grid Cols 1 md:Cols-3 lg:Cols-5 (or staggered bento).
agents_grid.instructions: Dark theme block. 5 cards representing the ruthless AI advisors. Use pure black background with sharp 1px white/15 border (`border-white/15`). Apply hover effect: border turns red (#FF3B30) or blue (#007AFF) instantly (no ease, fast transition). Add data-testid='agent-card-1' through 5.

report_dossier.title: Every chart earns its place.
report_dossier.instructions: Use the 'brutalist_card' surface style (1px solid black borders with hard black drop shadows). Overlap elements slightly to create an 'editorial magazine layout' feel. Use images of abstract documents or mock charts. data-testid='dossier-bento-grid'.

process_steps.title: Idea in. Verdict out.
process_steps.instructions: Light section. Use massive typography numbers ('01', '02', '03') using Cabinet Grotesk or Anton. Separate steps using 1px solid black lines. Use mono-labels for the step titles.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.instructions: 3 Tiers (Starter, Builder, Founder). Highlight the 'Builder' tier by applying the yellow (#FFD60A) background. Keep others white. All with 1px black borders and hard shadows. Buttons must have data-testid='pricing-cta-starter', 'pricing-cta-builder', 'pricing-cta-founder'.

faq.title: The panel debates itself, too.
faq.instructions: Accordion style. Replace standard icons with brutalist '+' and '-' in a monospace font. Thick 2px black bottom border for each question. data-testid='faq-accordion-item'.

final_cta.title: Ship the idea that survives.
final_cta.instructions: Massive fluid typography (clamp or text-[8vw]). Font must span the full width. Red CTA button that inverts on hover. data-testid='final-cta-button'.

footer.instructions: Minimalist, tech-editorial footer. Grid-aligned text, large typographic logo on the bottom left, monospace links on the right.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 border-[1.5px] border-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-none
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 border-[1.5px] border-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-none shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:shadow-none active:translate-x-[4px] active:translate-y-[4px]

components.accordion: Use Shadcn accordion but strip Vercel styling. Add thick borders, use mono font for triggers.

motion_and_interaction.easing: Instant or very fast. Brutalism hates slow easing. Use duration-100 or duration-150.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Hard background inversions (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white). Translate card shadows on click (simulate physical button pressing).
motion_and_interaction.scroll_effects: Use a react-fast-marquee for the text 'DEBATE YOUR STARTUP IDEA UNTIL IT BREAKS' to create kinetic texture separating sections.

assets.icons: lucide-react (using sharp/straight versions where possible) or phospher icons with 'bold' weight.

images.description: Abstract shapes to represent the 5 AI advisors. Apply grayscale and high contrast filters via CSS.
Background texture for the dossier bento grid to give it a physical report feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk, Anton, or Bebas Neue for headers. Load JetBrains Mono for micro-labels.
Do NOT alter the Hero section structure, but ensure the new sections share the same design tokens.
Rely heavily on pure black (#000000) and off-white/cream (#F4F4F0) for background sections to create a harsh contrast.
Use standard <div> components for the brutalist bento grids; avoid relying on Shadcn <Card> unless you heavily strip out its soft shadows and rounded corners.
Every button, input, and interactive element MUST have the specified data-testid attributes.
Files should be written in .js (JSX) format, not .tsx.
For shadows, use hard shadows: shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)] instead of blur-based Tailwind shadows.
